fusions.name: Rehearsed Nip
fusions.desc: A drilled bite that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 12% faster for 2 seconds afterward. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Whole Maze at Once
fusions.desc: You run a practised circuit through every enemy within 3 tiles, biting each for 26 damage. Every hit is a critical hit, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Run It Again
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and skitters you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Thousandth Lap
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
